messages:
nina: Quick status check on Optimize toolkit delivery — we need a short sync on quant recommendations, batching defaults, and the failing evals. Who's owning the final integration into the console?

sam: I can own console wiring for the rollout. Will need an API contract from eng-ml for the new quant profiles.

maya: I can finalize quant profiles (8-bit, 4-bit-safe) by EOD tomorrow. still debugging one regression on long-context summaries.

albert: FYI runtime needs a minor change to accept `quant_profile` in model config. PR up: https://git.redwood/eng/runtime/pull/412 — please review.

dominik: CI flaky on gpu-compat tests after quant PR, looks like kernel version mismatch on the canary pool. I'm investigating.

maya: @albert — sending the minimal profile schema here: ```
profiles:
  - name: quant_8_safe
    type: int8
    fallback: float16
    notes: preserve-kv-cache
```

sam: perfect. console expects `model.config.quant_profile` key. albert please ensure backward compat.

albert: yep will keep default null -> existing behavior. adding validation in PR.

maya: regression detail: eval-suite/long_summaries shows Rouge drop ~6 pts with 4-bit on distil model. Might be a prompt-sensitive failure not quant itself. I'm adding targeted evals to isolate.

nina: Who's owning the batching/caching suggested defaults? We discussed increasing max_batch_size and enabling prefix caching by default for chat routes.

sam: I can propose defaults: max_batch_size=12 for GPU-backed hosted, prefix_cache=true for chat-carousel. Will add in console -> Optimize -> recommendations as a toggle.

dominik: Once defaults change we need to run SLO soak on dedicated pool. I'll schedule a 4-hour soak tonight.

ci-bot: [build #8762] runtime PR 412: unit tests passed, gpu-compat-suite failed (3/7). Logs: https://ci.redwood/builds/8762/logs

maya: tagging @nina @sam — I'll push a narrow eval and a short writeup in the PR so you can see tradeoffs.

sam: pinging reviewers on https://git.redwood/eng/console/pull/299, added screenshots and the new toggle flow. reviewers: @albert @maya @nina

albert: quick review later today. small comment on validation message wording.

nina: plan summary:
  - owner(quant profiles): maya (deliver EOD tomorrow)
  - owner(console wiring): sam (PR 299)
  - owner(runtime change): albert (PR 412)
  - infra soak & gating: dominik (soak tonight)
  - blocker: CI gpu-compat flakes (dominik + infra)
  - regression alert: maya will add targeted evals and link results in PRs

nina: if no blockers after soak, schedule canary rollout early next week. please post small release note blurb in this thread. :thumbsup:

dominik: noted, will post soak results by 1758001700.

ci-bot: [eval-run] optimize-evals/long_summaries/2025-11-12: failure on quant_4_priority_set (details in PR comment).

maya: got the eval failure, triage in progress. likely prompt tweak + fallback to 8-bit for that workload.

sam: thanks — i'll hold canary until we have either a mitigation or a roll-back path.

nina: awesome. async updates are fine — I'll compile into the weekly eng status. If anyone needs a quick call, 30min slot open 9am PT tomorrow.

albert: can do 9.

dominik: same.

maya: I'll be on the call if evals take longer, otherwise will post notes here.

ci-bot: [note] reminder: add `quant_profile` to model schema docs (docs PR: https://git.redwood/docs/pull/88)
